notes: All 12 views inspected. Turbofan cutaway on a yellow maintenance cradle: a fan with individually modelled swept blades, a spinner, a nacelle cut away along one side, multi-stage compressor and turbine discs with blades, an annular combustor in red, a core casing and an exhaust cone. The cut faces are capped and coloured rather than left open, and the internal blade rows are real geometry. The fan and core are a SEPARATE `_rotor` node, so a spin clip can be authored. The cutaway and cradle are intentional for a teaching/display model and the rotor is separable.
limitations: Stylised Cozy-kit palette rather than photoreal materials.
The nacelle is deliberately cut away; this is not a complete closed engine.
Stage counts are illustrative, not a specific engine model.
method: Visual inspection of local-model renders and technical reports
